text_block_list.text:
Just as lunch break was ending, I bumped 
right into Fuji Kiseki coming out of the 
infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
choice_data_list:
Did you need something in the nurse's 
office?

Did you have some business in the nurse's 
office?

text_block_list.text:
A pill dropped out of Fuji Kiseki's 
pocket...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It's just a little headache...! I'll be 
fine once I take some medicine...!

Though she tried desperately to hide it, 
Fuji Kiseki seems to be suffering from a 
terrible headache.
